capabilities: Fetch the webpage title when a URL is pasted and insert a titled Markdown link
Enhance an existing raw URL into a titled Markdown link via a hotkey
Overwrite the title of an existing Markdown link with the fetched title
Support pasting URLs on mobile via the standard paste action
extras: README notes that Google's Gboard clipboard shortcut does not trigger the paste event, so the plugin cannot handle pastes made through it.
problem: Pasting a URL into Obsidian leaves a bare link with no descriptive title unless you fetch and type the page title yourself.
summary: Link title fetcher that converts pasted or raw URLs into Markdown links titled with the webpage's title.
